title: The Journey editor keeps every block inside its own Journey and links only practices the author may use

source.ref: Journey audit 2026-11-17 (project thread: Dial in the Journey Wizard and Journeys)

detail: addModuleAction, addLessonAction, addExtraCreditAction and addPracticeBlockAction inserted the client's parent_id without checking it belongs to the Journey being edited, so a crafted call could hang a block under another Journey's phase: orphaned in its own tree, deleted with the other Journey's phase (parent_id on delete cascade, migration 20260617000000), and making that phase look full to reuseOrCreatePhase. addPracticeBlockAction and setBlockPracticeAction also linked any practice id, including another member's draft. Fixed 2026-11-17: parentInPlan refuses a parent that is not a block of this plan (a null parent is the top level), and loadUsablePractice admits an approved library practice, the author's own, or one in the Journey's Space.

verify.note: Fails if an add-block action stops checking the parent belongs to the plan, or a practice-linking action stops checking the practice is usable.
